messages.name: Awake
messages.description: Unity calls Awake when an enabled script instance is being loaded.

messages.name: FixedUpdate
messages.description: Frame-rate independent MonoBehaviour.FixedUpdate message for physics calculations.

messages.name: LateUpdate
messages.description: LateUpdate is called every frame, if the Behaviour is enabled.

messages.name: OnAnimatorIK
messages.description: Callback for setting up animation IK (inverse kinematics).

messages.name: OnAnimatorMove
messages.description: Callback for processing animation movements for modifying root motion.

messages.name: OnApplicationFocus
messages.description: Sent to all GameObjects when the player gets or loses focus.

messages.name: OnApplicationPause
messages.description: Sent to all GameObjects when the playing application pauses or resumes on losing or regaining focus.

messages.name: OnApplicationQuit
messages.description: Sent to all GameObjects before the application quits.

messages.name: OnAudioFilterRead
messages.description: If OnAudioFilterRead is implemented, Unity will insert a custom filter into the audio DSP chain.

messages.name: OnBecameInvisible
messages.description: OnBecameInvisible is called when the renderer is no longer visible by any camera.

messages.name: OnBecameVisible
messages.description: OnBecameVisible is called when the renderer became visible by any camera.

messages.name: OnCollisionEnter
messages.description: OnCollisionEnter is called when this collider/rigidbody has begun touching another rigidbody/collider.

messages.name: OnCollisionEnter2D
messages.description: Sent when an incoming collider makes contact with this object's collider (2D physics only).

messages.name: OnCollisionExit
messages.description: OnCollisionExit is called when this collider/rigidbody has stopped touching another rigidbody/collider.

messages.name: OnCollisionExit2D
messages.description: Sent when a collider on another object stops touching this object's collider (2D physics only).

messages.name: OnCollisionStay
messages.description: OnCollisionStay is called once per frame for every Collider or Rigidbody that touches another Collider or Rigidbody.

messages.name: OnCollisionStay2D
messages.description: Sent each frame where a collider on another object is touching this object's collider (2D physics only).

messages.name: OnConnectedToServer
messages.description: Called on the client when you have successfully connected to a server.

messages.name: OnControllerColliderHit
messages.description: OnControllerColliderHit is called when the controller hits a collider while performing a Move.

messages.name: OnDestroy
messages.description: Destroying the attached Behaviour will result in the game or Scene receiving OnDestroy.

messages.name: OnDisable
messages.description: This function is called when the behaviour becomes disabled.

messages.name: OnDisconnectedFromServer
messages.description: Called on the client when the connection was lost or you disconnected from the server.

messages.name: OnDrawGizmos
messages.description: Implement OnDrawGizmos if you want to draw gizmos that are also pickable and always drawn.

messages.name: OnDrawGizmosSelected
messages.description: Implement OnDrawGizmosSelected to draw a gizmo if the object is selected.

messages.name: OnEnable
messages.description: This function is called when the object becomes enabled and active.

messages.name: OnFailedToConnect
messages.description: Called on the client when a connection attempt fails for some reason.

messages.name: OnFailedToConnectToMasterServer
messages.description: Called on clients or servers when there is a problem connecting to the MasterServer.

messages.name: OnGUI
messages.description: OnGUI is called for rendering and handling GUI events.

messages.name: OnJointBreak
messages.description: Called when a joint attached to the same game object broke.

messages.name: OnJointBreak2D
messages.description: Called when a Joint2D attached to the same game object breaks.

messages.name: OnMasterServerEvent
messages.description: Called on clients or servers when reporting events from the MasterServer.

messages.name: OnMouseDown
messages.description: OnMouseDown is called when the user has pressed the mouse button while over the Collider.

messages.name: OnMouseDrag
messages.description: OnMouseDrag is called when the user has clicked on a Collider and is still holding down the mouse.

messages.name: OnMouseEnter
messages.description: Called when the mouse enters the Collider.

messages.name: OnMouseExit
messages.description: Called when the mouse is not any longer over the Collider.

messages.name: OnMouseOver
messages.description: Called every frame while the mouse is over the Collider.

messages.name: OnMouseUp
messages.description: OnMouseUp is called when the user has released the mouse button.

messages.name: OnMouseUpAsButton
messages.description: OnMouseUpAsButton is only called when the mouse is released over the same Collider as it was pressed.

messages.name: OnNetworkInstantiate
messages.description: Called on objects which have been network instantiated with Network.Instantiate.

messages.name: OnParticleCollision
messages.description: OnParticleCollision is called when a particle hits a Collider.

messages.name: OnParticleSystemStopped
messages.description: OnParticleSystemStopped is called when all particles in the system have died, and no new particles will be born. New particles cease to be created either after Stop is called, or when the duration property of a non-looping system has been exceeded.

messages.name: OnParticleTrigger
messages.description: OnParticleTrigger is called when any particles in a Particle System meet the conditions in the trigger module.

messages.name: OnParticleUpdateJobScheduled
messages.description: OnParticleUpdateJobScheduled is called when a Particle System's built-in update job has been scheduled.

messages.name: OnPlayerConnected
messages.description: Called on the server whenever a new player has successfully connected.

messages.name: OnPlayerDisconnected
messages.description: Called on the server whenever a player disconnected from the server.

messages.name: OnPostRender
messages.description: Event function that Unity calls after a Camera renders the scene.

messages.name: OnPreCull
messages.description: Event function that Unity calls before a Camera culls the scene.

messages.name: OnPreRender
messages.description: Event function that Unity calls before a Camera renders the scene.

messages.name: OnRenderImage
messages.description: Event function that Unity calls after a Camera has finished rendering, that allows you to modify the Camera's final image.

messages.name: OnRenderObject
messages.description: OnRenderObject is called after camera has rendered the Scene.

messages.name: OnSerializeNetworkView
messages.description: Used to customize synchronization of variables in a script watched by a network view.

messages.name: OnServerInitialized
messages.description: Called on the server whenever a Network.InitializeServer was invoked and has completed.

messages.name: OnTransformChildrenChanged
messages.description: This function is called when the list of children of the transform of the GameObject has changed.

messages.name: OnTransformParentChanged
messages.description: This function is called when a direct or indirect parent of the transform of the GameObject has changed.

messages.name: OnTriggerEnter
messages.description: When a GameObject collides with another GameObject, Unity calls OnTriggerEnter.

messages.name: OnTriggerEnter2D
messages.description: Sent when another object enters a trigger collider attached to this object (2D physics only).

messages.name: OnTriggerExit
messages.description: OnTriggerExit is called when the Collider other has stopped touching the trigger.

messages.name: OnTriggerExit2D
messages.description: Sent when another object leaves a trigger collider attached to this object (2D physics only).

messages.name: OnTriggerStay
messages.description: OnTriggerStay is called once per physics update for every Collider other that is touching the trigger.

messages.name: OnTriggerStay2D
messages.description: Sent each frame where another object is within a trigger collider attached to this object (2D physics only).

messages.name: OnValidate
messages.description: Editor-only function that Unity calls when the script is loaded or a value changes in the Inspector.

messages.name: OnWillRenderObject
messages.description: OnWillRenderObject is called for each camera if the object is visible and not a UI element.

messages.name: Reset
messages.description: Reset to default values.

messages.name: Start
messages.description: Start is called on the frame when a script is enabled just before any of the Update methods are called the first time.

messages.name: Update
messages.description: Update is called every frame, if the MonoBehaviour is enabled.

messages.name: Awake
messages.description: Called when an instance of ScriptableObject is created.

messages.name: OnDestroy
messages.description: This function is called when the scriptable object will be destroyed.

messages.name: OnDisable
messages.description: This function is called when the scriptable object goes out of scope.

messages.name: OnEnable
messages.description: This function is called when the object is loaded.

messages.name: OnValidate
messages.description: Editor-only function that Unity calls when the script is loaded or a value changes in the Inspector.

messages.name: Reset
messages.description: Reset to default values.

messages.name: HasFrameBounds
messages.description: Validates whether custom bounds can be calculated for this Editor.

messages.name: OnGetFrameBounds
messages.description: Gets custom bounds for the target of this editor.

messages.name: OnSceneGUI
messages.description: Enables the Editor to handle an event in the Scene view.

messages.name: Awake
messages.description: Called as the new window is opened.

messages.name: CreateGUI
messages.description: CreateGUI is called when the EditorWindow's rootVisualElement is ready to be populated.

messages.name: OnBecameInvisible
messages.description: Called after the window is removed from a container view, or is no longer visible within a tabbed collection of EditorWindow.

messages.name: OnBecameVisible
messages.description: Called after the window is added to a container view.

messages.name: OnDestroy
messages.description: OnDestroy is called to close the EditorWindow window.

messages.name: OnFocus
messages.description: Called when the window gets keyboard focus.

messages.name: OnGUI
messages.description: Implement your own editor GUI here.

messages.name: OnHierarchyChange
messages.description: Handler for message that is sent when an object or group of objects in the hierarchy changes.

messages.name: OnInspectorUpdate
messages.description: OnInspectorUpdate is called at 10 frames per second to give the inspector a chance to update.

messages.name: OnLostFocus
messages.description: Called when the window loses keyboard focus.

messages.name: OnProjectChange
messages.description: Handler for message that is sent whenever the state of the project changes.

messages.name: OnSelectionChange
messages.description: Called whenever the selection has changed.

messages.name: Update
messages.description: Called multiple times per second on all visible windows.

messages.name: OnAssignMaterialModel
messages.description: Feeds a source material.

messages.name: OnPostprocessAllAssets
messages.description: This is called after importing of any number of assets is complete (when the Assets progress bar has reached the end).

messages.name: OnPostprocessAnimation
messages.description: This function is called when an AnimationClip has finished importing.

messages.name: OnPostprocessAssetbundleNameChanged
messages.description: Handler called when asset is assigned to a different asset bundle.

messages.name: OnPostprocessAudio
messages.description: Add this function to a subclass to get a notification when an audio clip has completed importing.

messages.name: OnPostprocessCubemap
messages.description: Add this function to a subclass to get a notification just before a cubemap texture has completed importing.

messages.name: OnPostprocessGameObjectWithAnimatedUserProperties
messages.description: This function is called when the animation curves for a custom property are finished importing.

messages.name: OnPostprocessGameObjectWithUserProperties
messages.description: Gets called for each GameObject that had at least one user property attached to it in the imported file.

messages.name: OnPostprocessMaterial
messages.description: Add this function to a subclass to get a notification when a new Material is created during an import of a ModelImporter.

messages.name: OnPostprocessMeshHierarchy
messages.description: This function is called when a new transform hierarchy has finished importing.

messages.name: OnPostprocessModel
messages.description: Add this function to a subclass to get a notification when a model has completed importing.

messages.name: OnPostprocessPrefab
messages.description: Gets a notification when a Prefab completes importing.

messages.name: OnPostprocessSpeedTree
messages.description: Add this function to a subclass to get a notification when a SpeedTree asset has completed importing.

messages.name: OnPostprocessSprites
messages.description: Add this function to a subclass to get a notification when an texture of sprite(s) has completed importing.

messages.name: OnPostprocessTexture
messages.description: Add this function to a subclass to get a notification when a texture2D has completed importing just before Unity compresses it.

messages.name: OnPostprocessTexture2DArray
messages.description: Add this function to a subclass to get a notification when a texture2DArray has completed importing just before Unity compresses it.

messages.name: OnPostprocessTexture3D
messages.description: Add this function to a subclass to get a notification when a texture3D has completed importing just before Unity compresses it.

messages.name: OnPreprocessAnimation
messages.description: Add this function to a subclass to get a notification just before animation from a model (.fbx, .mb file etc.) is imported.

messages.name: OnPreprocessAsset
messages.description: Add this function to a subclass to get a notification just before any Asset is imported.

messages.name: OnPreprocessAudio
messages.description: Add this function to a subclass to get a notification just before an audio clip is being imported.

messages.name: OnPreprocessCameraDescription
messages.description: Add this function to a subclass to receive a notification when a camera is imported from a Model Importer.

messages.name: OnPreprocessLightDescription
messages.description: Add this function to a subclass to recieve a notification when a light is imported from a Model Importer.

messages.name: OnPreprocessMaterialDescription
messages.description: Add this function to a subclass to recieve a notification when a new material is created during the import of a ModelImporter.

messages.name: OnPreprocessModel
messages.description: Add this function to a subclass to get a notification just before a model (.fbx, .mb file etc.) is imported.

messages.name: OnPreprocessSpeedTree
messages.description: Add this function to a subclass to get a notification just before a SpeedTree asset (.spm file) is imported.

messages.name: OnPreprocessTexture
messages.description: Add this function to a subclass to get a notification just before the texture importer is run.
